title: About Me 👤

title: Projects 🚀
text:
Here are the projects I’ve worked on — combining data, code, and curiosity.




Tools: SQL, R
Explored Formula 1 racing data using SQL queries to extract and analyze driver performance, race results, and championship standings. Combined SQL with R to visualize key insights from decades of F1 history.



GitHub








Tools: R, Tidytext, ggplot2
Performed text mining and sentiment analysis across 3 academic journals. Used natural language processing techniques to identify themes, word frequencies, and emotional tone across different publications.



GitHub








Tools: R, devtools, ggplot2
Independently designed and built aRtpalette — an R package that provides curated color palettes for data visualization. Inspired by art and aesthetics, this package makes it easy to create beautiful, cohesive plots in R.



GitHub








Tools: Quarto, HTML, CSS, GitHub Pages
Built and deployed this personal portfolio website from scratch using Quarto and GitHub Pages. Designed a bold, colorful theme with custom CSS and clean navigation to showcase my work and skills.
